title: unknown_timing_medications() has no call site, so skipped medications are never reported
method: call-site sweep of cura/ + end-to-end 'cura rehearse'

must_not_contain: has no call site in cura/

observed_at_discovery: A sweep of cura/ (excluding the definition and its own docstring) returns zero call sites; no test references it either. Confirmed end to end: a config with Warfarin recorded 'with lunch' produced a 'cura rehearse' transcript naming Warfarin in neither the morning nor the evening script, and no warning anywhere. pytest exit 1, 1 failed 1 passed.
